title: Is Text All You Need? Text as a Universal Information Bottleneck for Speech LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2606.09366v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) provide a powerful reasoning backbone for speech understanding, but integrating continuous acoustic signals into a pretrained LLM remains challenging. A central design question is how to tie speech representations to the LLM's text input space while preserving the continuous variation needed for different speech tasks. In this work, we propose Convex Gate (C-Gate), a speech-LLM bridge that represents each frame as a convex combination of frozen token embeddings. This architectural convex-hull constraint fixes the output codebook while allowing continuous mixtures learned from task supervision. With a Whisper-large-v3 encoder, a partially adapted Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct decoder, and joint training on speech recognition, emotion recognition, and spoken reasoning, C-Gate performs accurate transcription and emotion recognition, our representative semantic and acoustic tasks, through one shared decoder. translated_title: 文本就是你所需要的一切吗？文本作为语音大语言模型的通用信息瓶颈
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）为语音理解提供了强大的推理骨干，但如何将连续的声学信号整合进预训练的LLM仍然是一个挑战。一个核心的设计问题在于，如何将语音表示与LLM的文本输入空间相衔接，同时保留不同语音任务所需的连续变化特性。在本工作中，我们提出了凸门控（Convex Gate, C-Gate），这是一种语音-LLM桥梁，它将每一帧语音表示为冻结词元嵌入的凸组合。这一架构上的凸包约束固定了输出码本，同时允许通过任务监督学习到连续的混合权重。借助Whisper-large-v3编码器、部分适配的Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct解码器，以及在语音识别、情感识别和口语推理上的联合训练，C-Gate通过单一共享解码器即可实现准确的转录与情感识别——即我们代表性的语义任务和声学任务。
tldr: 提出凸门控（C-Gate）方法，将每帧语音表示为冻结词元嵌入的凸组合，以此作为语音与LLM文本输入空间之间的桥梁，用单一共享解码器同时完成语音转录和情感识别这两类语义与声学任务。
en_tdlr: C-Gate represents each speech frame as a convex combination of frozen token embeddings, bridging speech into an LLM's text input space and enabling accurate transcription and emotion recognition through a single shared decoder.
